charts.title: TOI-6109 b: orbits around TOI-6109
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-6109's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-6109 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Dattilo et al. 2025 (2025AJ....170..318D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname DATTILO_ET_AL_2025): P 5.690476 d

charts.title: TOI-6109 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-6109 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (18, 58, 85) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 384984325, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 10 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 14 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 10 min late; 4-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 5 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
